factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'During mid-2025, electricity tariffs in the Jiangsu and Anhui provinces were adjusted... These changes have now taken effect and reduced the realized price per kWh by approximately 8 percent... We assess that the impact on our existing project portfolio is manageable...'

factual_claims.claim: Gigasun remains focused on securing equity for continued expansion, as access to capital is identified as the primary bottleneck for growth.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Strategy section: 'In 2024, the company began a strategic review with the goal of securing capital for the company’s long-term growth objectives... For electricity producers like Gigasun that specialize in distributed solar PV systems, the biggest potential bottleneck for growth within the segment is access to capital to finance new projects.'

factual_claims.claim: The company does not intend to pay a dividend in the foreseeable future, prioritizing reinvestment into its growing portfolio.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividend section: 'For the foreseeable future, Gigasun will focus on growth and does not intend to pay a dividend in the next few years... The Board will evaluate the dividend issue annually. The Board of Directors proposes that no dividend be paid for 2025.'

numerical_claims.claim: Total revenue increased by 9.8 percent to SEK 239.7 million, up from SEK 218.3 million in the previous year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Multi-year overview table: Total revenue 239,655 (2025) vs 218,264 (2024) thousand SEK

numerical_claims.claim: Electricity production increased by 30 percent to 328 million kWh, compared to 253 million kWh in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'During the year, 327.8 (252.6) million kWh were generated...'

numerical_claims.claim: Installed capacity grew by 16 percent to 395.8 MW from 340.1 MW.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'At the end of the year, the company had 395.8 (340.1) MW installed, revenue-generating capacity.'

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit (EBIT) rose by 21.1 percent to SEK 73.5 million from SEK 60.7 million in the prior period.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million...'

numerical_claims.claim: EBIT margin expanded to 31 percent from 28 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit grew to SEK 195.8 million, maintaining a stable gross margin of 82 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement: Gross profit 195,829 thousand SEK with Gross margin% of 82% for both years

numerical_claims.claim: Cash flow from operating activities amounted to SEK 101.1 million, decreasing from SEK 133.8 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: 'Cash flow from operating activities 101,058 (2025) vs 133,785 (2024) million SEK'

numerical_claims.claim: Net loss was SEK -7.2 million vs SEK -32.9 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million.'

numerical_claims.claim: Net loss included a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 million and a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: -3.8 million SEK currency effect, 3.5 million SEK one-off cost
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: -3.8 million SEK currency effect, 3.5 million SEK one-off cost
numerical_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Profit for the year amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.'

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Adjusted for the currency effect and the one-off item, profit amounted to SEK 0.1 (-34.7) million...'

numerical_claims.claim: Interest expenses decreased to SEK 76.9 million from SEK 84.2 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement: 'Interest expenses and similar charges 76,944 (2025) vs 84,165 (2024) million SEK'

numerical_claims.claim: Signed 17 contracts representing 41.7 MW of new capacity.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The Company signed 17 (15) contracts representing total installed capacity of 41.7 (56.6) MW.'

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'At the end of the year, the company had 16.4 (38.8) MW in signed orders.'

numerical_claims.claim: Electricity tariffs were adjusted, reducing realized prices by approximately 8 percent in the second half of the year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'During mid-2025, electricity tariffs... reduced the realized price per kWh by approximately 8 percent... in the second half of the year.'
